te: Briefing by the OAE and the Department of Climate Change on plans to prepare agriculture
se: The meeting considered the agricultural action plan for climate change, its effects on agriculture, food security and biodiversity, and progress on the draft Climate Change Act B.E. ...., inviting the Office of Agricultural Economics and the Department of Climate Change and Environment
it: Agricultural action plan for climate change
Progress on the draft Climate Change Act B.E. ....

te: Briefing by the FDA on chemical oversight and the draft Chemicals Act
se: The meeting considered the rules for controlling and overseeing chemicals under the national chemical management strategy and the Hazardous Substances Act B.E. 2535 (1992), compared with the ideas in the draft Chemicals Act B.E. ...., and invited a representative of the Food and Drug Administration to give information
it: Chemical oversight and the ideas in the draft Chemicals Act B.E. ....

te: Effects of climate change on food security
se: The meeting noted an overview of how climate change affects farming systems and world food security, citing the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) that if global temperatures rise by more than 1.5 degrees Celsius, agricultural output will be affected
it: Effects of climate change on farming and food systems

te: Pesticide residues in food, and promoting safe food
se: The meeting noted information on food safety risks from pesticides, which can contaminate food both at the source of production and through imported goods, and on approaches to promoting safe food systematically
it: Pesticides in food, and approaches to safe food

te: Work begins: order appointing the food security subcommittee noted
se: The meeting noted the order appointing the subcommittee, whose duty is to study the situation and trends in food security and food safety, analyse risk and supporting factors, gather information from documents, meetings and study visits, and report to the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives. It also considered how it will work
it: Order appointing the subcommittee
How the work will be done

te: Meeting 1/2568 · Subcommittee to Study Food Security
Meeting 7/2568 · Subcommittee on Developing and Promoting Water Sources and Land for Agriculture
Executive summary of the northern flood report revised
se: The meeting considered the executive summary of the draft report on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities. It felt that creating liveable cities needs awareness about water, legal changes so that agencies can work together, and community participation, and that the responsible agencies and targets should be stated clearly. It resolved that the secretariat revise the text as proposed
it: Executive summary of the draft report on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities

te: Lack of land title documents for farmland in Lamphun, and the draft flood report
se: The meeting considered the Lamphun Provincial Farmers Council's proposal on the lack of title documents for farmland and homes, which makes it hard to obtain state services and GAP certification. It invited the Department of Lands, the Royal Forest Department and provincial agencies to clarify, and asked the Department of Lands to work with the province to summarise the facts and consider setting up a provincial committee to establish them, reporting within 15 days. It also continued its consideration of the draft report on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities
it: Lack of title documents for farmland and homes, Lamphun Province
Draft report on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities

te: Draft report on floods in the North revised
se: The meeting considered the draft report on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities, and asked for the objectives to be aligned with the title, the executive summary to be made concise, more academic work to be researched as references, and the findings and recommendations to be made clear and complete, for presentation again at the next meeting
it: Draft study report on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities

te: 3 petitions on water sources in Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai received
se: The meeting considered 3 petitions: a request to follow up the Mae Tai La reservoir project in Phrao District, Chiang Mai Province; a request for help with the Ban Nong Kai project in Mae Taeng District, Chiang Mai Province; and a request for water gates to ease flooding and drought in Thoeng and Phaya Mengrai Districts, Chiang Rai Province. It invited a representative of the Royal Irrigation Department to clarify, and the petitioners and local people concerned gave information online
it: Follow-up of the Mae Tai La reservoir construction project, Chiang Mai Province
Request for help with the Ban Nong Kai project, Chiang Mai Province
Request for water gates to ease flooding and drought, Chiang Rai Province

te: Lamphun farmers' proposal for soil-cement core check dams
se: The meeting considered the Lamphun Provincial Farmers Council's proposal to develop farm water sources with soil-cement core check dams to solve water shortages and drought. It heard the Office of the National Water Resources, the Royal Irrigation Department and the Lamphun Provincial Administrative Organization, then proposed that the Lamphun PAO act as the central coordinator for agencies to prepare a draft water management plan and request a budget, and report progress from time to time
it: Proposal to develop farm water sources with soil-cement core check dams, Lamphun Province

te: Northern flood problems summarised, and changes proposed to compensation rules for longan orchards
se: The meeting summarised its study on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities, based on information from agencies and study visits to Chiang Rai, Lamphun and Chiang Mai. It found insufficient water storage, shallow waterways, forest management issues and agencies' legal limits, and will prepare a report with recommendations for the committee. It felt that the flood compensation rules for longan orchards, which use the criteria for annual crops, should be adjusted to suit perennial fruit trees, possibly using Senate mechanisms such as an interpellation or a discussion so that the government is informed
it: Study on solving floods in the North towards liveable and sustainable cities
Rules for compensating flood damage to longan orchards
2 letters from the Lamphun Provincial Farmers Council

te: Draft study report on the draft Longan Strategy Act considered (continued)
se: Agenda: draft report on the study of the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. .... (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119) (the Senate has not yet published the summary of this meeting, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Draft report on the study of the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. .... (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119)

te: Proposals on the draft Longan Strategy Act given
se: The meeting considered the draft report on the study of the draft Longan Strategy Act, and proposed that the law should aim to develop the whole longan production system into a high-value cash crop with standards and safety accepted in world markets; set clear strategies for production, marketing and product development; review the strategy every 5 years or when circumstances change; and review the action plan every year
it: Draft report on the study of the draft Longan Strategy Act B.E. .... (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119)

te: Draft report on developing an integrated rice system considered (continued)
se: Agenda: Draft study report on approaches to supporting, promoting and developing Thailand's integrated rice system (the Senate has not yet published the summary of this meeting, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Draft study report on approaches to supporting, promoting and developing Thailand's integrated rice system
